record.question: How does drug abuse contribute to suicidal behaviour?
options: Making the person more alert and aware
Enhancing thrill seeking which increases adrenaline
record.explanation: Answer B: Increasing depression and impulsivity. Substance use can worsen depression and impair inhibition/decision-making, increasing suicidal behavior risk. Source/context note: Risk is multifactorial; the item’s causal wording is simplified. Reference: https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/publications/suicide-faq. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
